name: Shar'n Clark
quote: I've done programs with Mel Robbins… and I feel that Wreck the Room is more beneficial. I got more out of it. I made major decisions, where when I did the other programs, I didn't. The benefit of Wreck the Room over other programs that I have done is the ability to check in and to have some kind of accountability. I didn't feel that in the other programs. It's worth more than what we paid.

name: Dr. Desiree King
quote: When organizations feel stagnant, it’s often because unseen barriers are still in place. Jody helps leaders and teams identify those barriers, break them down, and move to the next level of performance and alignment.

name: Dr. Desiree King
quote: Jody helps your company, your organization, and your people tear those walls down and take that corporation to the next level.

name: Abby Havermann
quote: When Jody spoke about ‘wrecking the room,’ it resonated immediately. His ability to connect personal experience to meaningful insight is what makes his work so impactful

name: Abby Havermann
quote: Jody's talk was so empowering and impactful. You felt him on the stage, and I could relate to so many of the experiences he was having. That's what a great speaker does!

name: Tiffany P.
quote: I walked out of there with so much conviction and so many key and pivotal pieces and tools... Jody is going to fulfill the need of ensuring that individuals understand how to rebuild their lives.

name: Amara P.
quote: Jody's framework doesn't just focus on changing behaviors. It helps you understand the identity underneath. When I came into this course, I thought it would be about working through things from my past. What I've really discovered is that I have begun to create a new blueprint for my future. Naming my room was a real turning point. It wasn't about blaming my past. It was about understanding where those patterns came from, and realizing that I had the freedom to choose differently.

name: Christy B.
quote: Jody's authenticity reflected back to me exactly where I want to be. It was so validating to hear Jody's story, and to hear how we can be who we are. I have a tendency to build my room and then quickly want to go to the next. Celebrating being in the room I built for a while is super important. It helps me really connect more to who I am. I do not believe I can do this alone. So grateful.

name: Christy B.
quote: Re-examining my personal values has been a game changer. It’s helped me say no more easily, say yes when it’s right for me, and my life has really blossomed.

name: Jeremy D.
quote: A lot of the smaller changes I'd made after being stuck were just minor renovations. Over the last 3 years, I've changed countries and careers. Jody's framework really helped me name where I'm at in that process. Now I'm looking forward to a big rebuild, and being intentional with my design instead of letting things happen to me and making minor course corrections.

name: Robert E.
quote: I took my first vacation in six years. I'm already planning the second one. I didn't see how much of my life I'd spent waiting for permission. Wrecking that room is what finally let me rest without guilt. It also took care of the thing I was most afraid of: sales. Once I stopped waiting for permission, I started asking for the business. Since then, our revenue has grown 10x.

name: Ran S.
quote: This helped me wreck beliefs that were in the way. It made so much sense and I could feel the shift.

name: Laurie G.
quote: This work leads to a better quality of life and being surrounded by people who support and understand you better.

name: Sergey R.
quote: Thank you very much! You inspire me to continue to work on my craft. And you continue to do it...Thank you very much! God bless you!!!!

name: Ian C.
quote: Jody goes above and I always recommend him as my mentor and highly recommended to anyone who wants to learn to grow their business

name: Clarence T.
quote: I am loving all the information! Very professional and well organized.  Thanks so much for this opportunity!
